second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 6 + Difficulty 4 = 20), pdf 64; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-20 monotonic (picture labels printed '06'-'09'), no gaps, no duplicates. BLUE PRINT 10/6/4 = 20 = audited count. Answer side prints keys 1-14: 1-4 match by number; 5-14 belong to another version of the questions (analysis file). Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 20.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 64 (heading, LO 3, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 65 (q5, pictures 06-09, match q10-13) 66 (q14-19, family-tree picture) 67 (q20 + bird picture). A side 'Key Answers: 16' pdf 117 (keys 1-14). Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE (analysed first): q1-q4 keyed by printed number. q5-q20 empty + 'key belongs to another paper version' with content pointers q5 <- 6, q16 <- 5, q6/q7/q9 <- 11/12/14, q8 <- 13 (doubtful: the picture is a young girl), q20 <- 9 (partial); keys 7, 8, 10 describe pictures this lesson does not print. q17-q19 'no answer printed'.

Sections: s1 I q1-5 (q2 two-sentence key -> sa, others vsa); s2 II pictures q6-9 (each with its own picture stimulus; text = instruction + picture label); s3 III match q10-13 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s4 IV q14-16; s5 q17 (family-tree picture stimulus); s6 q18 draw; s7 q19; s8 q20 (bird picture stimulus).
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): s1-s4 1; null where N disagrees (s5 '2*1=2', s6-s8 '4*1=4', each over 1 question).

FIGURES (v1.4 §14.10): 6 question-side pictures -> 6 stimuli (pdf 65 x4, pdf 66 family tree, pdf 67 bird family; the last two are each stored as two stacked image strips and cropped as one box). The family-tree picture carries printed English labels (Raju, Deepa, father, mother, grand father, grand mother, 1st-3rd generation) and Kannada labels — the crop is an image; no text is stored from it.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 20 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 3, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
Key typos kept in pointers verbatim ('Mother love har baby', 'Monky safe har baby').
PARKED (R-E8; T-E1): empty match q10-q13 cannot pass gate 2.20. Built in the work dir with its crops; not committed.
